prerequisite: none technically; the runbook orders it after the second person has signed in so the accept step can follow immediately
safeguards: demo organization only; the real organization is refused by name
is_demo derived from organizations.org_type, not from a flag
the issuer is read from the org's active org_owner row, never supplied, so an operator cannot forge who authorized a membership
the address is read at runtime, never printed, never stored
no email is sent; the table has no column for an address to send to
